title: Thai-Style Chicken Wrap
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired wrap filled with grilled chicken, crunchy vegetables, and flavorful spices.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the yellow Thai curry paste, soy sauce, and honey. Add the sliced chicken breast and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
2. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
3. Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to package instructions.
4. Warm the large flour wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
5. Assemble the wrap by adding the cooked chicken, cooked couscous, mixed vegetables, chopped cilantro, and chopped Thai basil leaves.
6. Drizzle with additional soy sauce and honey if desired.
7. Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
